name: @gjsify/webview2-native-win32-x64
description: win32-x64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/webview2-native. Installed automatically on win32/x64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.win32-x64: prebuilds.yml's `build-prebuilds-win32-webview2` job builds, gates and load-tests it on every run; `commit-prebuilds` lands it here on the first run on `main` and clears this exemption in the same commit
